answer: Sybil clones flood cheap votes. Mechanism: each new identity posts a stake plume of 12 POA into a 48-hour challenge pool, then must wander through 3 random peer quizzes that rehash its prior two epochs; only after all digests match does the stake anchor into a bonded seat for 7 days. Cost: 12 POA locked plus about 0.4 POA quiz fees. Verification: peers recompute digests from public seeds. Failure: any mismatch burns 4 POA and resets the window, so spawning 100 clones costs 400+ POA before earning.
